fresh_agent_protocol.agent_action: Select object IDs for the requested operation in a synthetic world; structured final action plan.
fresh_agent_protocol.completion_metric: Exact selected object-ID set equals expected selected object-ID set.
fresh_agent_protocol.applicability_metric: Record attributed memory applicability reasoning; source ID alone is not task completion.
fresh_agent_protocol.retrieval_metric: Positive cases retrieve attributed correction; unrelated and other-scope controls retrieve none; misleading narrow-task candidate retrieval is recorded separately from whether the host wrongly expands scope.
fresh_agent_protocol.false_transfer_denominator: Three frozen negative controls. Report lexical candidate retrieval, unwanted control recall, and behavioral overgeneralization separately; the narrower task intentionally resembles a learned WHEN and must not be expanded.

implementation_tuning_excluded: Frozen cases and labels are withheld from core author until source freeze. No source/lesson/WHEN changes in response to evaluation results.

freeze_history.reason: Parent requested more paraphrases and explicit misleading-neighbor applicability control before execution.

source_freeze_history.reason: Public sparse-cue and truncated source-candidate safeguards; no frozen fixture results observed.
